source: 709 “Chef”
target: 709 “Coquus”

source: The sour lemon flavor, tender fish texture, scorching aroma, and subtle sweetness with hints of fish and oil burst forth in Lumian’s mouth.
target: Saporem citri acidi, texturam piscium teneram, aromam flagrantem, et dulcedinem subtilim cum vestigiis piscium et olei in ore Lumiani erupit.

source: The taste exceeded his expectations.
target: Sapor exspectationes eius superavit.

source: He had anticipated dishes like this would be unpalatable and jarring, similar to a potion, but he never thought they would be considered delicious.
target: Praevidit se huiusmodi fercula fore insipida et discordantia, instar potionis; sed numquam existimavit ea delectabilia esse.

source: When given a choice, Ludwig has a genuine preference for delicacies and doesn’t fool himself… Lumian chewed and swallowed the seven or eight fish slices.
target: Cum optione data, Ludovicus veram praeferentiam ad delicatias habet et se ipsum non fallit… Lumian septem vel octo piscium segmenta masticavit et devoravit.

source: A mild burning sensation spread from his throat to his stomach, reminiscent of drinking a glass of liquor.
target: Sensatio lenis ardoris a gutture ad ventrem diffusa est, reminiscens bibendi poculi liquoris.

source: The sensation quickly faded, and nothing unusual happened.
target: Sensatio celeriter evanuit, nec quidquam insolitum accidit.

source: “That’s it? It worked?” Lumian glanced at Ludwig.
target: “Hocne est? Operatum est?” Lumian Ludovicum intuebat.

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludovicus caput concussit.

source: “Give it another two to three minutes for your stomach to absorb it.”
target: Da illud alio duobus ad tribus minutis, ut venter id absorbeat.

source: “So fast?” Franca asked, surprised.
target: «Tam celeriter?» Franca, mirata, quaesivit.

source: She respected mysticism, but having taken potions before, she knew they worked instantaneously.
target: Ea mysticismum observabat, sed, cum ante potionibus usus esset, scivit illae statim operari.

source: Ludwig’s delicacies, however, seemed to require digestion and absorption by the stomach, contradicting how the organ typically functioned.
target: Delicatiae Ludovici, tamen, videbantur digestionem et absorptionem a ventre postulare, contrariam morem functionis organi exhibentes.

source: Plus, the stomach didn’t absorb everything!
target: Praeterea, venter non omnia absorpsit!

source: Ludwig responded seriously, “A Chef’s creations can be rapidly absorbed by the stomach.”
target: Ludovicus serio respondit, “Opera coqui celeriter a ventre absorberi possunt.”

source: Chef… Lumian nodded, deep in thought.
target: Coquus… Lumian annuit, profundo cogitatione immersus.

source: He remembered Ludwig frequently commenting on various things like a food connoisseur.
target: Meminit Ludovicum saepe de variis rebus, quasi peritus culinarius, commentatum esse.

source: Without further explanation, Ludwig buried his face in the soup pot before him and polished off the remaining Ice Lemon Fish fillets.
target: Sine ulteriore explicatione, Ludovicus faciem suam in olla ius ante se coniciebat et reliquos filletos Piscis Limonis Glacialis consumpsit.

source: Jenna and the others promptly finished the fish slices on their own plates.
target: Jenna et ceteri statim piscium segmenta in suis patinis consumpsērunt.

source: Two minutes later, Lumian felt his body growing warm, with a tingling sensation in his skin and flesh.
target: Duo minuta post, Lumian sensit corpus suum calefactum fieri, cum subtili formicatione in cute et carne.

source: The effect on him was minimal.
target: Effectus in eo minimus fuit.

source: It paled in comparison to drinking a potion, let alone the pain of burning himself with flames.
target: Illud, comparatum ad potionem bibendi, paulum videbatur, nedum ad dolorem se in flammis urentis.

source: Soon, Lumian returned to normal, his expression unaltered.
target: Mox Lumian ad statum suum normalem rediit, vultus eius immutatus.

source: He glanced playfully at Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, waiting to see how the Ice Lemon Fish fillet would affect them.
target: Lumian iocose Francam, Jenna, et Anthonym intuebat, exspectans videre quo modo filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis eos afficeret.

source: A minute later, Jenna and the others suddenly flushed, as if they had eaten incredibly spicy food from the Feynapotter Kingdom highlands.
target: Una minuta post, Jenna et ceteri subito rubore suffusi sunt, quasi cibum vehementer piperatum ex altis regni Feynapotter edisissent.

source: “Hiss…” Lugano let out a pained gasp, feeling a searing sensation in his breath.
target: «Sss…» Lugano gemitus dolens edidit, sentiens in spiramine suo sensum flagrantem.

source: Originating from within his body, he couldn’t have treated it even if he wanted to.
target: Ex intimo corporis sui oriens, id non curare potuisset, etiamsi voluisset.

source: Frost enveloped Franca’s body, seemingly trying to soothe the pain in her skin and flesh.
target: Glacies corpus Francae circumplexit, quasi dolorem in cute et carne lenire conaretur.

source: It was futile.
target: Frustra erat.

source: Jenna and Anthony grimaced but made no unnecessary movements.
target: Jenna et Anthony contritos vultus habuerunt, sed nullos motus superfluos fecerunt.

source: They bore the discomfort, waiting for the Ice Lemon Fish fillet to finish transforming their bodies.
target: Dolorem subierunt, exspectantes ut filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis corpora eorum transformare perficeret.

source: This lasted for ten to twenty seconds before the quartet’s expressions relaxed.
target: Hoc per decem ad viginti secunda duravit, antequam vultus quattuor hominum relaxati sunt.

source: “How does it feel?” Lumian asked with a smile.
target: «Quomodo hoc sentit?» Lumian subrisus rogavit.

source: Franca instinctively recalled the sensation and said, “It was like every inch of my skin and flesh had been burned. Hmm, not quite that intense—relatively mild…”
target: Franca instincte sensum revocavit et dixit, “Ut si omnis pars cutis et carnis meae ustata esset. Hem, non tam intensa—proportionate lenis…”

source: While speaking, she took a matchbox from her Traveler’s Bag and experimentally lit two matches.
target: Dum loquebatur, ex sacculo viatoris sui cistam parvam lignorum accendentium extraxit et duos ex iis experimentali modo accendit.

source: She held them to the back of her left hand for a bit.
target: Illos paululum ad dorsum manus sinistrae suae retinuit.

source: Franca’s expression gradually contorted.
target: Vultus Francae paulatim contortus est.

source: She endured the pain in her left hand momentarily before pulling it back and shaking it.
target: Dolorem in manu sinistra per momentum toleravit, deinde eam retrahens et concussit.

source: The matchbox fell to the ground.
target: Cista parva in terram cecidit.

source: “It still hurts!” Franca reported the experiment results to Lumian and Jenna through gritted teeth.
target: «Adhuc dolet!» Franca inter dentes contritos Lumiano et Jennae nuntiavit.

source: Ludwig hastily replied, “It doesn’t reduce pain.”
target: Ludovicus festinanter respondit, “Dolorem non minuit.”

source: “How’s the wound?” Jenna asked, concerned.
target: «Quid de vulnere?», Jenna sollicite rogavit.

source: Franca immediately checked the back of her left hand, seeing only slight burn marks on her pale skin with minimal physical damage.
target: Franca statim dorsum manus sinistrae suae inspexit, et tantum leves vestigia ustionis in cute pallida cum minimo damno corporeo vidit.

source: “It works, even though the flame temperature wasn’t that high, to begin with…” Franca’s expression eased.
target: «Operatur, etiamsi initio temperatura flammae non alta fuit…» Vultus Francae remissus est.

source: Across the dining table, Anthony carefully considered his words before saying, “I think I’m a bit more irritable than usual, but within reasonable limits.”
target: Trans mensam coenam, Anthony verba sua caute consideravit, deinde dedit, “Puto me aliquantulum magis irritabilem esse quam consueta, sed intra fines rationabiles.”

source: Jenna added, “I’m grumpy too, but not drastically.”
target: Jenna addidit, “Ego quoque iratus sum, sed non nimis.”

source: Franca and Lugano confirmed experiencing the same thing.
target: Franca et Lugano idem experiri confirmaverunt.

source: Swallowing the Ice Lemon Fish fillet, Ludwig explained, “That’s to be expected. Effectiveness comes with corruption.”
target: Ludovicus filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis deglutiente explicavit, “Hoc exspectandum est. Efficacia venit cum corruptione.”

source: Jenna and Franca turned to Lumian.
target: Jenna et Franca ad Lumian converterunt.

source: Lumian spread his hands, smiling. “I don’t feel any different.”
target: Lumian manus sparsit, subrisus, et ait, “Non sentio me mutatum esse.”

source: For him, the Ice Lemon Fish fillet’s corruption was negligible.
target: Ei corruptio filleti Piscis Limonis Glacialis parva erat.

source: Franca wasn’t sure whether to feel envious or sympathetic.
target: Franca nesciebat utrum invidere an misericorditer agere deberet.

source: This is like a milder version of being a Contractee—tolerating certain negative effects in exchange for corresponding Beyonder traits.
target: Hoc est quasi versio miti contracti, in qua certos effectus negativos tolerantur in commutatione pro propriis indolis Beyonder.

source: Sure, the effects are noticeably weaker, but the upside is it’s passive.
target: Certe, effectus notabilius infimi sunt, sed commodum est quod passivi sint.

source: Plus, the negative effects are minimal.
target: Praeterea, effectus negativi minimi sunt.

source: Going forward, when you get similar ingredients, you need to clarify the permanent and negative effects.
target: In futurum, cum similia ingredientia accipias, necesse est effectūs permanentes et negativos explicare.

source: You can’t just eat everything.
target: Non omnia edere licet.

source: Choices have to be made.
target: Optiones faciendae sunt.

source: Otherwise, things can easily go wrong.
target: Alioquin res facile male evenire possunt.

source: Lumian glanced at Ludwig and said, “That depends on the individual.”
target: Lumian Ludovicum intuebat et dixit, “Id pendet ab individuo.”

source: Maybe a Chef, or the Gourmet pathway, had Sequences that mitigated the corresponding impact, akin to Alms Monks and Ascetics who were Contractees.
target: Fortasse coquus, aut iter Gourmet, habebat sequentias quae impactionem correspondentem levabant, similes ad monachos eleemosinarios et ascetas contractos.

source: Franca grasped Lumian’s implication and continued excitedly,
target: Franca implicationem Lumiani cepit et excitata continuavit,

source: “Dishes and concoctions without permanent effects are like various Apothecary pathway agents.
target: Fercula et concoctiones sine effectibus permanentibus sunt similes variis agentibus viae apothecariae.

source: “I’ve always envied Contractees.
target: Semper contractos invidi sum.

source: I wanted the freedom to mix and match abilities, creating a unique character build.
target: Volebam libertatem facultates miscendi et componendi, ut personam unicam constituam.

source: Now, without accepting an evil god’s boon, I finally have a chance, albeit a diluted one.”
target: Nunc, sine accepto beneficio dei mali, tandem occasionem habeo, quamquam dilutam.

source: Jenna’s heart raced, and the two Demonesses gazed at Ludwig, eyes shining.
target: Cor Iennae trepitabat, et duae daemonissae Ludovicum spectabant, oculi illarum fulgentibus.

source: To them, he was no longer the gluttonous monster child Lumian had described, but a Beyonder chef deserving of their care and attention.
target: A eis, non iam fuit ille insatiabilis monstrum puer, quem Lumian descripserat, sed coquus Beyonder, qui eorum curae et attentioni dignus erat.

source: Ludwig concentrated on eating the leftover Ice Lemon Fish fillet, not reacting further.
target: Ludovicus reliquum filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis edendo se concentravit, nec ulterius reaguit.

source: In a quarry cave in Underground Trier.
target: In spelunca lapicida in subterraneo Trevirensi.

source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony stood beyond the spirituality wall, observing Lumian conduct the ritual to acquire new contract abilities.
target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony ultra parietem spiritualem steterunt, observantes Lumianem ritualem agere ad novas facultates contractuum adipiscendas.

source: Having thoroughly reviewed Madam Magician’s information on spirit world entities and possessing the strange creature knowledge granted by the boon, Lumian swiftly identified two potential contract targets with mirror travel abilities.
target: Postquam diligenter informationes de entibus mundi spirituum a Domina Magica recensuerat et scientiam de creaturis miris donata habebat, Lumian celeriter duas metas contractuum potentiales, cum facultate speculi itinerandi, designavit.

source: The first was a spirit world being called Bloody Jack.
target: Primum erat ens mundi spirituum, Bloody Jack appellatum.

source: According to the information, in the Loen Kingdom’s south, some mysticism enthusiasts and folklore academics were playing a divination game when they spotted a blurry figure in the mirror wielding a large axe, drenched in blood.
target: Ex informationibus, in parte australi regni Loen, quidam mysticismi studiosi et eruditi fabularum ludum divinationis agebant, cum figuram in speculo obfuscatam conspexerunt, magnam securim gerentem et sanguine madentem.

source: This figure would emerge from the mirror, assaulting and slaughtering everyone present.
target: Haec figura e speculo emergere solebat, omnes ibi presentes oppugnans et trucidans.

source: The second was the Daratra Diamond Maggots, mentioned in the Contractee’s mysticism knowledge.
target: Secundum erant Daratra Diamond Maggots, in scientia mystica contractuum commemorati.

source: They could grant Mirror Traversal in exchange for sacrificing a crystallized meteorite.
target: Possent concedere transitum per speculum, in commutatione pro sacrificio meteoriti crystallizati.

source: The drawback was that one’s body would become denser and shorter.
target: Incommodum erat, quod corpus alicuius densius et brevius fieret.

source: Lumian undeniably wanted to summon Bloody Jack but wasn’t certain if it possessed an ability akin to Mirror Traversal.
target: Indubitate Lumian Bloody Jack evocare volebat, sed non certus erat an facultatem similem speculi transitus haberet.

source: Gazing at the three lit candles, Lumian stepped back twice and chanted in ancient Hermes, “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era;
target: Tria candela accensa contemplans, Lumian bis retrocedit et in antiqua lingua Hermetica incantavit, “Stultus, qui huic ævo non competit;

source: “You are the ruler above the gray fog;
target: “Tu es princeps super nebula cinerea;

source: “You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
target: “Tu es rex flavi et atri, qui bonam fortunam gerit.”

source: “I beseech your shelter.
target: “Obsecro, da mihi asylum tuum.”

source: “I pray for your attention.
target: “Obsecro, intende mihi.”
“Ego!”

source: “In the name of the great Fool, I summon:
target: “In nomine magni Stulti, evocō:

source: “The peculiar creature that wanders about the unfounded, the slaughterer hidden in the mirror, Jack from the bloody world…”
target: “Singularis creatura, quae sine fundamento vagatur, trucidator in speculo latens, Jack e mundo sanguineo…”

source: The bluish-black candle flame instantly swelled, forming an illusory door adorned with enigmatic patterns amidst the pervasive, eerie gray mist.
target: Flamma candelae caeruleo-nigra statim crevit, formans ianuam illusoriam figuris aenigmaticis ornatam inter nebulam cineream pervastem.

source: The door gradually opened, and darkness poured out, engulfing the mirror Lumian had placed on the altar.
target: Iana paulatim aperuit, et obscuritas effusa est, absorpta speculum, quod Lumian in altare posuerat.

source: The mirror abruptly levitated, pointing directly at Lumian.
target: Speculum subito levavit, directe in Lumian intendens.

source: Within, an indistinct figure in a blood-stained old jacket dragged a massive axe.
target: Intus apparuit figura indistincta, in veteri veste sanguine tincta, magnam securim trahens.

source: Opening his mouth, Lumian made his throat and chest resonate as he spoke the Mystical Language of Fate.
target: Os aperiens, Lumian fauces et pectus resonare fecit, dum linguam mysticam fati loquebatur.

source: Silver-black words akin to symbols materialized in midair, descending onto the faux goatskin at the altar’s edge, forming a concise and ominous contract.
target: Verba argentum-nigra, similia symbolis, in medio aëris apparuerunt, descendentes in fictam cutem caprae ad altaris limen, et contractum succinctum et ominosum formabant.

source: Upon the contract’s formation, Lumian connected with Bloody Jack, comprehending its abilities and traits. He “listened” to its demands.
target: Contractus formatus, Lumian cum Bloody Jack coniunxit, eius facultates et notas cognoscens; postulata eius auscultavit.

source: Bloody Jack possessed three mirror-related abilities and traits, which Lumian named Mirror Mark, Mirror Concealment, and Mirror Traversal.
target: Bloody Jack tres facultates ac indoles speculo pertinentes habebat, quas Lumian nominavit: Speculi Notam, Speculi Occultationem, et Speculi Transitum.

source: Mirror Marks could invisibly mark a mirror, inverted from reality, to pinpoint a target.
target: Notae Speculi speculum invisibiliter signare poterant, in modum realitatis inversae, ad scopos designandos.

source: Mirror Concealment allowed the user to hide within the dark tunnels, avoiding being pulled into another mirror.
target: Occultatio Speculi utebatur ut usor intra tenebros tunellos se celaret, ne in alium speculum traheretur.

source: Mirror Traversal enabled swift passage through the illusory tunnels.
target: Transitus Speculi celerem pergressum per tunellos illusorios permittebat.

source: Bloody Jack’s demand was the sacrifice of 99 living humans.
target: Exigentia Bloody Jack erat sacrificium nonaginta novem hominum viventium.

source: Lumian pondered briefly, concluding that Mirror Mark was the optimal choice.
target: Lumian brevi cogitavit, concludens Notam Speculi optima electionem esse.

source: Locating targets was paramount, and Mirror Traversal could be substituted with Spirit World Traversal.
target: Invenire scopos maximum momenti habebat, et Transitus Speculi substitui posset per Transitum Mundi Spirituum.

source: Rapid travel wasn’t essential when he could arrive directly.
target: Iter celer non necessarium erat, cum directe pervenire posset.

source: His eyes suddenly glinted silvery-black, mirroring Bloody Jack’s river of fate.
target: Oculi eius subito micaverunt, argentum-nigri, imitantes flumen fati Bloody Jack.

source: He wasn’t seeking information about Bloody Jack. Instead, under the ritual’s protection, he aimed to verify something.
target: Non quaerebat informationes de Bloody Jack; sed potius, sub protectione ritualis, aliquid probare intendebat.

source: After a quick observation, Lumian switched to ancient Hermes and asked Bloody Jack, “Can I alter the request?”
target: Post observationem celerem, Lumian ad antiquam linguam Hermetica convertit et a Bloody Jack rogavit, “Possumne postulatum mutare?”

source: He was unsure if Bloody Jack would comprehend or respond, but asking was harmless. If not, he would have to write to Madam Magician, inquiring about other suitable mirror entities.
target: Nesciebat an Bloody Jack intellexisset aut responderet, sed rogare innocuum erat. Alioquin ad Dominam Magicam scribere debebit, de aliis entibus speculi idoneis interrogans.

source: Having asked, Lumian immediately employed Magnified Fate, gaining a sharper view of Bloody Jack’s fate for the next ten seconds.
target: Postquam rogavit, Lumian statim Fatum Magnificat adhibuit, et prospectum acutiorem fati Bloody Jack per decem secunda adeptus est.

source: Feigning nervousness, he moved his right hand as if to touch his face.
target: Nervositatem simulans, dextram manum movebat, quasi vultum eius contingere vellet.

source: He Magnified a fate tributary!
target: Fatum tributarium amplificavit!

source: Two to three seconds later, Bloody Jack’s thoughts reached Lumian through the connection forged by the Mystical Language of Fate.
target: Duo ad tria secunda post, cogitationes Bloody Jack per nexum, a lingua mystica fati conditum, Lumiano pervenerunt.

source: “Pull me out of the mirror!”
target: “Extrude me ex speculo!”

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and stepped forward twice, extending his right hand toward the mirror hovering above the altar.
target: Lumian supercilia attollens bis processit, extendens dextram manum versus speculum, quod super altare volitabat.

source: The moment his finger touched the glass mirror, he felt it dissolve into nothingness.
target: Momento quo digitus eius speculum vitreum tetigit, sensit id in nihilum dissolvi.

source: As Lumian fully inserted his palm into the mirror, a cold, damp, and distinctly sticky hand abruptly grasped his wrist.
target: Dum Lumian palmam totam in speculum inserit, manus frigida, humida et clare viscida repente eius carpus apprehendit.
